source: Lawnchair qualification issue #22; NOT a device test

cases.preconditions: Before install, inspect approved full Git commit SHA, CI run/artifact, SHA-256, aapt package/version and apksigner certificate.
cases.expected_observation: Exact candidate APK matches source SHA and expected package/version/signer before any installation.

cases.preconditions: Keep existing One UI Home installed and record current HOME without changing the role.
cases.expected_observation: Existing Home fallback can be explicitly reselected; no removal of working launcher.

cases.preconditions: With owner permission, deny RECORD_AUDIO during visible Start.
cases.expected_observation: No microphone/foreground capture starts; an actionable error is shown.

cases.preconditions: Owner grants microphone for test only and visibly taps Start.
cases.expected_observation: Only one owner-started foreground session with discoverable End and notification.

cases.preconditions: Cancel permission/start or dismiss controls before starting.
cases.expected_observation: No hidden mic capture or silent subsequent service restart.

cases.preconditions: After owner start, background launcher and lock phone.
cases.expected_observation: Document actual foreground notification and capture state; never infer continuity.

cases.preconditions: Start, then activate End from UI and notification independently.
cases.expected_observation: Actual mic and foreground service cease; no silent automatic restart.

cases.preconditions: With explicit consent, select and invoke target default assistant.
cases.expected_observation: Correct assistant route enters visible UI; original role recorded for rollback.

cases.preconditions: With no assistant-role grant, invoke supported assistant entry.
cases.expected_observation: No false role success or forced Settings/role write; safe explicit handoff.

cases.preconditions: During controlled paired test session, disable test tailnet network.
cases.expected_observation: Honest connection/retry state; no mistaken VPN permission or silent command retry.

cases.preconditions: Revoke disposable paired token using private desktop admin flow.
cases.expected_observation: New requests reject; session handling and recovery shown without token leakage.

cases.preconditions: Owner mutes session, plays synthetic spoken inbox reply, then unmutes.
cases.expected_observation: User mute persists during/after TTS; no echo or overlap with user/Realtime speech.

cases.preconditions: Use original Lawnchair QSB and regular search provider when voice disabled.
cases.expected_observation: Native search, app drawer and dock behavior preserved.

cases.preconditions: Return HOME, widgets, folders, hotseat, Recents and app drawer.
cases.expected_observation: No baseline layout/data loss or unsupported window move.

cases.preconditions: Create Scratch/normal test spaces and restart/import disposable launcher backup.
cases.expected_observation: Normal spaces/pins restored, Scratch not durable; no widget/folder loss.

cases.preconditions: Configure disposable hidden/uninstalled/work-profile shortcut then reopen Spaces.
cases.expected_observation: No hidden/work identity leak or unauthorized cross-profile launch.

cases.preconditions: User requests supported personal-profile adjacent/split two-app test.
cases.expected_observation: Record actual visible two-window vs fullscreen/one-app/no-op independently of intent success.

cases.preconditions: Where feature advertised, request public launch bounds with disposable app.
cases.expected_observation: Observe real window geometry; setLaunchBounds return alone is NOT verified placement.

cases.preconditions: Enable TalkBack and 200% font; navigate mic/end/Spaces and dialogs.
cases.expected_observation: Readable stop controls and logical focus order with no clipped accessible actions.

cases.preconditions: After all approved tests, restore original HOME/assistant, mic and app state.
cases.expected_observation: Owner explicitly verifies rollback, no uninstall/pm clear/private dump upload.
